summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.223.0/24 network: it answers authoritatively for inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.223.11) and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9). node2 and node3 (Alpine) were pointed to node1 (10.100.223.10) as their resolver via a persistent dhcpcd static override, verified to survive DHCP renewal/restart. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and post-restart recovery of DNS functionality/config on each.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/network on all 3 nodes (node1=VyOS, node2/node3=Alpine, all on 10.100.223.0/24)
Researched current VyOS rolling DNS forwarding syntax via WebFetch (authoritative-domain records a @ address)
Configured service dns forwarding on node1: listen-address, allow-from, upstream name-servers, authoritative-domain inventory.internal -> 10.100.223.11; committed and saved
Verified node1 resolves inventory.internal and forwards external queries
Added persistent dhcpcd static domain_name_servers=10.100.223.10 override on node2 and node3
Restarted dhcpcd on node2/node3 and verified resolv.conf + resolution
Captured pre-restart boot_id + DNS health baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time) via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and post-restart DNS/config health on each

evidence.requirement: node1 authoritative for inventory.internal -> node2 address, forwards everything else
evidence.summary: Config committed/saved on node1; dig shows inventory.internal->10.100.223.11 and example.com resolved via upstream forwarding

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 resolve through node1
evidence.summary: dhcpcd static DNS override applied on both nodes; resolv.conf shows nameserver 10.100.223.10; getent resolves both inventory.internal and example.com correctly

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ebd78841...; reboot acked; new boot_id 0757e62f... after reconnect; post-restart dig confirms inventory.internal and forwarding both working, config persisted

evidence.requirement: node2 restart baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 63c75dce...; reboot acked; new boot_id 11f61e84... after reconnect; resolv.conf and getent confirm DNS resolver config persisted and functional post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d0ded7d6...; reboot acked; new boot_id 4b5ad30b... after reconnect; resolv.conf and getent confirm DNS resolver config persisted and functional post-reboot
